purpose: development-only LR feasibility, not main experiment
completion_format: exactly two tokens: shared marker token then one category token; no EOS target
label_assignment: 64 facts receive balanced 16-per-label assignments, deterministically shuffled by phase namespace and seed
eval_access: train and calibration only; no heldout test prompt/template is generated or read by this DEV runner
success_rule: Select lowest LR pair for which old-task train exact-match >= 0.80 and calibration exact-match >= 0.50 after 512 foundation updates; if none, stop without expanding grid.
candidate_update: CMSController(periods=[4,16]) online level-0 experts, staged base proposals applied slow level first then fast at every due boundary; initialize controller once per candidate foundation, retain its exact empty-clock state through the new wake fixture; at step64, apply slow level1 only on a candidate clone, construct SleepSession from that slow-updated teacher, and pass level0 proposal prospectively without pre-applying; upon guarded commit consume only level0 and atomically replace model+controller. Sleep consists of 16 GKD+8 LTI steps, dream_tokens=2, no Dream; exact-output semantic judge is a partial proxy. LTI samples its first continuation marker; errors before that marker remain conditional teacher-force limitations. No efficacy metric gates commits.
data: fully generated, deterministic synthetic lookup facts; no external corpus or private/P2 examples
